root.description: A customer record page in a CRM

parts.description: Record header: customer name, company, status badge and owner
Tabs

slots.overview: Overview tab: who the customer is (contact, company, deals, notes)
slots.activity: Activity tab: what happened and what is next (timeline, emails, meetings, tasks)

parts.description: Card titled "Key facts": a boxed summary
Contact details: email, phone, address
Company profile: industry, size, website
Deals (open, with stage and amount)
Notes the team wrote about this customer
Activity timeline: one chronological feed of everything logged on the record, newest first
Email threads with this customer
Upcoming and past meetings
Follow-up tasks for this customer
Current subscription: plan, seats, renewal date
Invoices: each bill sent to the customer, with its amount and due date
Payment history and the card on file
